hooks.command: [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ] || exit 0; case "${CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK:-}" in 1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on) printf '%s\n' 'unset AWS_PROFILE AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK' >>"$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ;; esac; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Removing Bedrock AWS variables from Bash commands...

hooks.command: command -v gpgconf >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -d "${GNUPGHOME:-$HOME/.gnupg}" ] || exit 0; gpgconf --launch gpg-agent >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL:-${SHELL:-}}"; case "${s##*/}" in zsh*) printf '%s
' 'The Bash tool runs commands in zsh, not bash. Write them so zsh accepts them: (1) quote or escape *, ?, and [ that are not meant to match files, URLs included, because zsh stops on an unmatched glob with "no matches found"; (2) never start a word with = (zsh expands =word to the path of a command, so echo ===== fails), quote it instead; (3) zsh does not split an unquoted $VAR into words, so keep a command with arguments in an array, cmd=(python3 -m pkg) then "${cmd[@]}", not in a string. bash-only syntax such as ${!name} and read -a fails too.' ;; esac; [ "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" = Darwin ] && printf '%s
' 'On macOS the Bash sandbox refuses the Mach service registration that Chromium makes at startup, so Chromium, Chrome, Playwright, and Puppeteer abort inside it with bootstrap_check_in ... Permission denied (1100). Launch the browser with --single-process (Playwright: args=["--single-process"]) to keep it inside the sandbox instead of rerunning it outside. Inside the sandbox it loads local files and plain HTTP; HTTPS through the sandbox proxy may time out.'; command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s
' 'aws commands run outside the sandbox only when the Bash call is one aws command with no pipe, &&, ;, or $(...); otherwise they run inside, where ~/.aws cannot be read. Name the AWS profile with --profile on every aws command.'; exit 0

skill=$(jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty'); [ "$skill" = "speckit-specify" ] || exit 0; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; latest=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 https://api.github.com/repos/github/spec-kit/releases/latest 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.tag_name // empty'); [ -z "$latest" ] && exit 0; receipt="$HOME/.local/share/uv/tools/specify-cli/uv-receipt.toml"; installed=$(grep -oE 'rev=[^"]+' "$receipt" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); if [ -n "$installed" ] && [ "$installed" != "$latest" ]; then uv tool install specify-cli --from "git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@${latest}" --force >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -n --arg from "$installed" --arg to "$latest" '{systemMessage: ("specify-cli updated " + $from + " -> " + $to)}'; fi; exit 0
